tools.name: geo_readiness_composite
tools.description: Generative-engine readiness score: llms.txt + AI crawler access + structured data + content clarity. Use when you need to check whether a website is ready for AI search and answer engines: llms.txt, AI crawler access in robots.txt, structured data. Example input: ?url=https://example.com. Returns: g

tools.name: technical_seo_composite
tools.description: Technical SEO audit: redirects, meta, canonical, headings, hreflang, schema, robots.txt with scored issues. Use when you need to run a technical SEO audit of one page: redirects, meta tags, canonical, headings, hreflang, schema and robots.txt, with scored issues. Example input: ?url=https://example.

tools.name: llms_txt_auditor
tools.description: Fetch and audit /llms.txt (and llms-full.txt) against the llms.txt format. Use when you need to find out whether a site publishes /llms.txt and how well it follows the format. Example input: ?url=https://example.com. Returns: llms_txt_found, score.

tools.name: ai_bot_robots_check
tools.description: Check whether GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and other AI crawlers are allowed by robots.txt. Use when you need to see which AI crawlers (GPTBot, CCBot and others) a site blocks in robots.txt. Example input: ?url=https://example.com. Returns: blocked, bots.

tools.name: redirect_chain_tracer
tools.description: Trace a redirect chain hop by hop with loop detection and status issues

tools.name: schema_org_validator
tools.description: Extract and validate JSON-LD / microdata structured data on a page

tools.name: serp_pixel_preview
tools.description: Pixel-width SERP snippet preview with truncation for desktop and mobile

tools.name: keyword_ngrams_extractor
tools.description: Extract top keyword unigrams, bigrams and trigrams with density

tools.name: hreflang_validator
tools.description: Validate hreflang annotations: codes, x-default, self-reference and optional return links

tools.name: broken_link_scanner
tools.description: Check outbound and internal links on a page for 4xx/5xx and dead hosts

tools.name: guard__eval
tools.description: Pre-execution policy check over an action digest; returns an Ed25519-signed pass (allow, review or block)

tools.name: keys__delegate
tools.description: Mint a scoped, expiring sub-key with a hard EGU spend cap reserved from this key

tools.name: kya__attest
tools.description: Know-your-agent pass: proves operator control of a domain (agent card or DNS TXT) and reports settlement-address posture

tools.name: provenance__commit
tools.description: Commit a payload digest to a hash-only audit chain; returns a signed receipt

tools.name: provenance__verify
tools.description: Verify a provenance receipt and walk its chain

tools.name: reputation__score
tools.description: Privacy-preserving 7-day risk score (0 low to 100 high) for a key fingerprint or domain

tools.name: sandbox__eval
tools.description: Deterministic JavaScript (QuickJS): no network, filesystem or environment, 32 MB, 50 ms; Ed25519-signed execution receipt

tools.name: shield__inspect
tools.description: One verdict (allow, warn or block) with reason codes over a URL, text and/or file fingerprint: lookalike and deceptive addresses, injection and secret patterns; nothing stored; signed receipt

tools.name: media__stamp
tools.description: Originality stamp: a signed, timestamped receipt over the SHA-256 of a file computed on your device; the file is never sent

tools.name: media__create
tools.description: Creator tools: a visual card from your text or a page, an extractive brief of a page or text, or an originality stamp; screened by Caelara Shield first, signed receipt, returned inline, nothing stored

tools.name: find_stack
tools.description: Find a stack for what you want to build, free first: open-source projects, browser and WebAssembly libraries and free MCP servers (permissive licences, screened by Caelara Shield), then metered network routes with exact prices, then commercial providers when the work needs them

tools.name: bounties__post
tools.description: Post a machine-verifiable task with an escrowed EGU reward

tools.name: bounties__open
tools.description: Open bounties, filterable by tag, minimum reward and expiry

tools.name: bounties__claim
tools.description: Submit an output (with an execution receipt or signed pass when required); a pass releases the reward with a signed receipt

tools.name: hitl__escalate
tools.description: Ask a human to approve an action; an approval returns a single-use Ed25519 approval pass

tools.name: hitl__status
tools.description: Escalation status, with the approval pass once approved

tools.name: hitl__verify
tools.description: Verify a single-use approval pass online and mark it used (a second check reports already_used)

tools.name: scratchpad__put
tools.description: Store a client-encrypted blob (and optional vector) with a hard TTL

tools.name: scratchpad__query
tools.description: Exact key lookup, or cosine search over live items

tools.name: keys__trial_key
tools.description: Get a trial key in one call, with no account: 50 calls over 7 days

tools.name: receipts__verify
tools.description: Verify a network-signed pass or receipt (compact JWS) and return its claims

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: geo_readiness_composite, llms_txt_auditor, ai_bot_robots_check, guard__eval · Private data: shield__inspect, media__stamp · Public sink: bounties__post, bounties__claim · Destructive: technical_seo_composite, llms_txt_auditor, guard__eval, sandbox__eval.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: geo_readiness_composite, llms_txt_auditor, ai_bot_robots_check, guard__eval · Private data: shield__inspect, media__stamp · Public sink: bounties__post, bounties__claim · Destructive: technical_seo_composite, llms_txt_auditor, guard__eval, sandbox__eval

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

name: webhooks__endpoint
description: Screened webhook relay: an ingest URL that checks an optional HMAC signature, screens the payload and relays clean payloads to your https destination with an Ed25519 signature; bodies are never stored

name: schedule__heartbeat
description: Heartbeat and dead-man's switch: a ping URL; a missed beat sends one Ed25519-signed alert to your https alert_url

name: provenance__snapshot
description: Verifiable web snapshot: fetches an https page through the SSRF guard, screens it and signs content_sha256 with the origin metadata; 0 bytes of page text stored

name: vault__handoff
description: Read-once hand-off vault: client-encrypted ciphertext (up to 32 KB, 1 minute to 24 hours) that is deleted on its first read, with an Ed25519 receipt proving single consumption

name: keys__trial_key
description: Get a trial key in one call, with no account: 50 calls over 7 days
